meta_jurisdiction_context.sovereign_country_en: Arab Republic of Egypt (جمهورية مصر العربية)
meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Egypt (national unitary jurisdiction; no sub-state corporate tax distinction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Napoleonic-inspired); Islamic Sharia is the principal source of legislation per Constitution Article 2 but is confined mainly to personal-status matters; commercial and corporate affairs are governed by the Egyptian Civil Code (Law No. 131/1948), Companies Law No. 159/1981, Investment Law No. 72/2017 and the Commercial Code.

Egypt-UK Double Taxation Agreement (in force since 1980)
Egypt-China Bilateral Investment Treaty (in force since 1996)
Egypt-China Double Taxation Agreement (in force since 1997)
Egypt-EU Euro-Mediterranean Association Agreement (in force since 2004)
Unified Agreement for the Investment of Arab Capital in the Arab States (1980, as amended)
Egypt-Germany Bilateral Investment Treaty and Double Taxation Agreement (both in force)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: The AML/CFT architecture is governed by Law No. 80/2002 on Combating Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing (قانون مكافحة غسل الأموال رقم 80 لسنة 2002), as amended (including Law No. 78/2003, Law No. 181/2008 and subsequent amendments), its Executive Regulations, and the directives of the Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combating Unit (EMLCU - وحدة مكافحة غسل الأموال وتمويل الإرهاب), an autonomous unit attached to the Administrative Control Authority. Corporate UBO disclosure derives from Companies Law No. 159/1981, the Investment Law No. 72/2017 and its Executive Regulation (Cabinet Decree No. 2316/2017), and Prime Ministerial Decree No. 58/2020 on Beneficial Owner registration with GAFI. Anti-terrorism financing obligations are reinforced by the Anti-Terrorism Law No. 94/2015 and asset-freezing orders issued by the Public Prosecutor and competent courts. Payment rails (TikTok Creator Payout and Wise B2B) are subject to the Central Bank of Egypt AML/CFT rulebook and the electronic-money regulations. FATF Recommendations 10, 12, 22 and the UN Security Council resolutions are applied as baseline standards. Processing of founder and creator identity data must also respect the Personal Data Protection Law No. 151/2020.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access - GAFI and the Commercial Register maintain UBO records that are not publicly searchable; disclosure is owed to GAFI, the Egyptian Tax Authority, EMLCU and competent investigative and mutual-legal-assistance authorities. Nominee and trust layers are disfavoured and must be pierced to the natural person; nominee arrangements remain fileable but are not exempt from UBO declaration.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copies and proof of identity for each founding shareholder and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport/identity authority of each founder's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (where the issuing state is an HCCH-1961 party) plus certified Arabic translation; non-HCCH states require consular legalization at the Egyptian Embassy or Consulate in the state of issuance

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and constitutional documents of the corporate shareholder (if any foreign corporate shareholder is used)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry of the foreign corporate shareholder's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization, followed by certified Arabic translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing (valid extract) of any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization by the Egyptian consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney appointing the GAFI one-stop-shop agent, local lawyer or service representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the shareholder's country of domicile
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization, Hague Apostille or consular legalization, and certified Arabic translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board resolution of the corporate shareholder approving the incorporation of the Egyptian LLC, its shareholding percentage, and appointment of its directors
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board/secretary of the corporate shareholder, notarized in the home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization, plus certified Arabic translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference or capital-provenance letter covering the founders' funds to be contributed to share capital
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Banks where the founders maintain accounts
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized signature of the bank officer and, if required by GAFI, apostilled/consular-legalized through the bank's home jurisdiction

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, UBOs, directors, authorised signatories, major creator-partners and counterparties against UN Security Council Consolidated Lists (Resolutions 1267, 1988, 1989), Egypt's domestic terrorist-entity listings under Law No. 94/2015, OFAC SDN and non-SDN sanction lists, EU consolidated asset-freezing lists, UK OFSI consolidated list, and Egypt's official fugitive and terrorist lists published in the Official Gazette. PEP status is determined using commercial risk intelligence (e.g., Refinitiv/World-Check, Dow Jones) and FATF Recommendation 12 requires senior-management approval, source-of-wealth and source-of-funds documentation, and enhanced ongoing monitoring for any PEP, their family members and close associates. Continuous re-screening is triggered on every TikTok Creator Payout settlement, any Wise B2B transfer above USD 10,000, any change in UBO concentration, and any new high-value talent or advertiser onboarding.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) One-Stop-Shop (OSS) investor services, combined with the Ministry of Justice Commercial Register (السجل التجاري) national database and the Ministry of Trade and Industry electronic commercial registry system. Name reservations are lodged on the GAFI 'Company Name Reservation Request' form at OSS centres in Cairo, Giza, Alexandria and the Suez Canal region, or through the GAFI digital investor services platform.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory corporate name must be expressed in Arabic. A Latin-script transliteration may be registered as a secondary trade style for international contracts, TikTok/digital brand and payment-platform use, but the Arabic name governs all official filings, the tax card and the Commercial Register extract. The transliteration must be a phonetic transcription of the Arabic name using standard Egyptian Latinization practice and must not create deceptive similarity to existing registered names or trademarks. Foreign geographic or personal elements may appear only if transliterated into Arabic and not contrary to public order.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank - بنك (requires Central Bank of Egypt license; prohibited for unlicensed LLC)
Insurance or Insurance Brokerage - تأمين / وساطة تأمين (requires Financial Regulatory Authority license)
Securities, Financial, Brokerage - أوراق مالية / تمويل / وساطة (requires FRA license)
National, Egyptian, Governmental, General, Authority, Ministry - قومي / مصري / حكومي / عام / هيئة / وزارة (prior ministerial approval required; high refusal rate)
Islamic, Jihad, Military, Security - إسلامي / جهادي / عسكري / أمني (public-order and security clearance required)
International, Global, World - دولي / عالمي (scrutinised; subject to proof of substantive cross-border business)
Holding - هولدينج / قابضة (reserved for entities actually incorporated as holding companies under Law No. 159/1981)
Free Zone or Offshore - منطقة حرة / خارجي (misleading because the LLC is an onshore Egyptian tax resident)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law No. 159 of 1981 (Companies Law for Joint Stock Companies, Partnerships Limited by Shares and Limited Liability Companies), as amended by Law No. 4 of 2018; Limited Liability Company provisions under Articles 82 to 104; supplemented by Investment Law No. 72 of 2017, Article 16 (One-Stop Shop), with Executive Regulations issued by Prime Ministerial Decree No. 2310 of 2017; Commercial Registry Law No. 34 of 1976.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: The General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) — Companies Registration Department and One-Stop Shop (Investor Services Center), Ministry of Investment and Foreign Trade.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Incorporation application ('Talab Al-Ta'sis') together with the certified Arabic Memorandum and Articles of Association ('Aqd Al-Ta'sis wa Al-Nizam Al-Asasi') of the Limited Liability Company, registered under ISIC 7310 / NAICS 541810.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: LLC minimum capital of EGP 50,000 (approx. USD 1,000) fully subscribed and paid-up at formation. The full amount must be deposited before incorporation in a blocked escrow/formation account opened in the name of 'the company under formation' at a licensed Egyptian bank; withdrawal is permitted only after the GAFI certificate of incorporation and commercial registration are obtained.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST ORGANIZATIONAL RESOLUTION OF THE LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY — RESOLVED unanimously by the founders in an organizational meeting of EG LLC: (1) that the subscribed capital of EGP 50,000 paid into the blocked formation account is accepted, the capital deposit certificate is ratified, and share allocations are approved in accordance with the certified Articles of Association; (2) that the registered office is formally adopted at the address specified in the Articles of Association, and the managers are authorized to execute the lease and notify GAFI; (3) that the named natural persons are appointed as General Manager and Finance Officer with sole joint-representation powers; and (4) that incorporation filings, tax registration, and all licensing applications are hereby approved and delegated.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Ministry of Finance, Arab Republic of Egypt; e-Tax and e-Invoicing portal: https://www.eta.gov.eg
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity must apply to the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) for a Tax Identification Number (TIN) prior to commencing taxable activities in Egypt. The application requires: an officially attested certificate of incorporation, the parent company board resolution authorizing the Egyptian registration, the local commercial registry certificate, a notarized power of attorney appointing a resident tax representative, evidence of the main place of business, and the LLC's constitutional documents. For VAT purposes, the same TIN serves as the VAT ID, but the entity must ensure its tax file includes a specific VAT registration endorsement; mandatory VAT registration is triggered automatically upon exceeding the statutory turnover threshold. The ETA may in practice require appointment of an accredited tax agent or fiscal representative for foreign-owned companies.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election is available under Egyptian law. LLCs are taxed at the entity level as juridical persons under Law No. 91 of 2005. A limited election exists for consolidated filing of companies forming part of the same group (85% ownership or control, with Ministry of Finance approval), and for accelerated depreciation. Hybrid mismatch elections are not available in domestic law; only reporting obligations apply under transfer pricing rules. For investments inside Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCEZ) tax-exempt zones, a formal election may be made to apply the preferential free-zone tax regime instead of the general income tax regime.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under Law No. 67 of 2016 as amended
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 annual taxable turnover for mandatory registration; EGP 250,000 for voluntary simplified SME registration
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Egypt operates a real-time e-invoicing and e-receipt framework administered by the ETA. Taxpayers are required to integrate their billing systems with the ETA e-invoice portal through secure APIs, digitally sign invoices, assign QR codes per invoice, and submit data to the ETA for fiscal clearance and validation before/within close to real-time. Mandatory phases apply by taxpayer category; non-compliance blocks operations and triggers fines. A digital fiscal stamp (e-stamp) and digital certificate must be embedded in every transaction document covered by the mandate.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating is granted for: (i) exported goods leaving Egypt; (ii) services performed for non-residents and used wholly outside Egypt, paid in freely convertible foreign currency, and provided under a contract evidencing offshore consumption; (iii) services directly connected to international transport. For an MCN agency, zero-rating applies only to commissions and production services rendered to foreign TikTok brands/talent where the agent proves foreign currency remittance, non-resident counterparties, and economic utilization occurring outside Egypt.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Turkey/Ajir style approved form) or ACI/SIS integrated export declaration
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing physical export
Inward Remittance Certificate issued by an Egyptian bank showing transfer of export proceeds in convertible foreign currency
Service Contract or Statement of Work confirming offshore delivery
ETA e-invoice for the export supply bearing the zero VAT rate and QR code
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The ETA conducts document-intensive audits on zero-rated export invoices, especially for cross-border services, and may reclassify supplies as taxable at 14% if the exporter fails to prove foreign exchange repatriation, foreign utilization, or non-resident identity. Penalties include: interest on under-declared VAT at market lending rates plus a daily penalty (0.5%–1% of the tax amount per month), fines of up to 5,000 EGP per e-invoice violation, criminal sanctions for forgery of export documentation, and full retrospective clawback of any refunds claimed together with a 50% evason penalty for fraudulent zero-rating claims. The bank-issued inward remittance certificate is strictly checked against CBE repatriation windows.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE), regulated under Central Banking and Monetary System Law No. 194 of 2020, Banking Law No. 88 of 2003, and CBE Foreign Exchange circulars administered through the Foreign Exchange Control Directorate.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Unified free-float interbank regime effective December 2022; USD/EGP is market-determined with periodic CBE intervention to manage liquidity. Current-account service payments and fees are convertible upon submission of underlying contracts, invoices, and purpose-of-payment forms (A-1 declarations). Capital-account inflows (share capital, shareholder loans) and profit/dividend remittances are permissible but subject to documentary review, clearing of corporate tax obligations, and ministerial reporting thresholds. De facto convertibility risk exists at the bank-counterparty level where transaction substantiation is poor or where the USD shortage scenario re-emerges.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Service export proceeds (including TikTok global platform receivables) must be received in Egypt within 10 months from the date of invoice under CBE banking instructions. No mandatory conversion ratio applies; exporters may retain 100% of proceeds in a Foreign-Currency Account at an authorized dealing bank and sell into the interbank at their discretion. Crediting of USD proceeds requires presentation of the service agreement and invoice to the corporate bank.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: EGP Operational Account + USD Foreign-Currency Account
EGP Operational Account + USD Priority Account
EGP Operational Account + USD Retained Proceeds Account
EGP Operational Account + USD Receivables Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Rating: Medium-Low. Egypt does not issue primary EMI/digital-virtual-bank licences to non-bank fintechs; licensed EMIs (e.g., Wise) cannot legally open resident EGP accounts in Egypt. Wise Business may be retained exclusively as an offshore USD disbursement rail for creator payouts and global TikTok settlements, but all Egyptian corporate inflows must still land into a bank account held at a licensed Egyptian authorized dealer.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is effectively mandated. Authorized dealers require the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) and the two statutory directors to attend an in-branch onboarding interview in Egypt; no fully remote opening is available for foreign-owned LLCs. Remote/video attestation is accepted only for subsequent account signatories after the initial physical meeting at banks such as CIB or NBE.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Foreign UBO (UAE/Gulf based) with no prior Egyptian tax history
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified passport copy of UBO, commercial registry extract of the foreign parent, board resolution appointing the Egyptian GM, signed agency/management agreement delegating local control, and bank reference letter from the UBO's home bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: MCN business classification flagged as 'exposed digital/creator-economy activity' with uncertain revenue traceability
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: TikTok global creator-programme contract, ISIC 7310 business description certificate, forecast of TikTok settlement statements, and Ministry of Communications digital-services registration confirmation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Absence of physical office at time of account opening
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Lease or usufruct contract for the Egyptian office space, police-form landlord ID copies, and utility bill in the company name; must be procured before onboarding.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Initial capital injection from offshore in excess of EGP 500,000 in one transfer
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Source-of-funds file: audited parent-company financials, bank statements covering the funding period, notarized board resolution approving the equity injection, and the completed A-1 capital-purpose declaration.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Outbound creator disbursements to overseas beneficiaries perceived as high-risk cross-border payment funnels
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Finalized creator talent-management contracts with each material payee, TikTok Creator Marketplace statements substantiating the catalog of creators, payee KYC documentation, and the bank's non-objection to the Wise Business payout rail.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route via SWIFT MT103 from the foreign parent's bank to the Egyptian entity's USD account at CIB or NBE. Wire narrative must state 'Capital Injection for EG LLC' with purpose code P-31 (capital contribution) to enable the bank's A-1 declaration. The Egyptian bank will credit the USD account, obtain the central-bank declaration ID, and the company may then sell USD into EGP at the interbank rate with same-day settlement for operational funding.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Creator payouts: funded in EUR/USD from the Egypt USD account via SWIFT MT103 to Wise B2B beneficiary pools; smaller creator disbursements are batched through Wise using payments initiated against fully reconciled creator invoices. Settlement of recurring creator balances is a normal commercial service payment, requiring evidence of the TikTok statement. Large outbound settlements above USD 50,000: executed via the dealing bank's international division using SWIFT MT103 for the payment order plus MT202 for cover, supported by the service contract and tax clearance. Documentary credit (Commercial LC) is not required for service disbursements; it applies only to physical import transactions, but the bank may request a standby LC guarantee from TikTok Global to confirm the receivable.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore CBE-authorized cash currency forwards against confirmed service invoices (back-to-back, non-speculative only; tenor aligned with TikTok settlement schedule)

Offshore non-deliverable bounds (NDFs) in USD-EGP transacted outside Egyptian borders on a best-efforts basis; Egyptian banks are restricted from writing onshore NDFs, so the hedge counterparty must be the foreign parent or an offshore trading venue

Intercompany currency swap between EG LLC and the foreign parent on the principal balance of retained USD receivables vs EGP operating expenses, documented via a commercial ISDA-style swap governed by English law
Natural hedge via retention of USD receipts in the onshore Foreign-Currency Account and matching USD outbound creator disbursements, reducing conversion frequency

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 3 months from fiscal year-end; for calendar-year taxpayers by 31 March
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 2% per month on unpaid tax due, default assessment by ETA, interest accrual, and possible criminal prosecution for willful non-filing

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Audited Financial Statements and Shareholders' Meeting Approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: GAFI (General Authority for Investment) and Company File at the Commercial Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months from fiscal year-end; for calendar-year taxpayers by 30 June
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file audited accounts may trigger GAFI administrative warning, monetary penalties, and in persistent cases administrative strike-off of the company

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local District Authority (El-Mahalla) and Commercial Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 January of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal incurs administrative fines of increasing daily/monthly amounts; non-renewal can result in license suspension and closure of the business premise

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the anniversary of the original tax registration date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Expired tax card may be used as grounds for contract withholding penalties; continued non-renewal can lead to tax ID suspension and enforced compliance measures

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO and Ownership Register Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual confirmation at each Ordinary General Assembly, no later than 30 June; immediately upon any share transfer
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance may trigger fines under Egypt's Anti-Money Laundering Law 80/2002 and administrative penalties from GAFI; failure to update on ownership changes can render transfers unenforceable

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory for all Egyptian LLCs without de minimis exemption; at least one licensed auditor must be appointed and audited financial statements must be presented to shareholders annually
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS) based on IFRS; IFRS required for listed entities

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The register must capture any share transfers and underlying UBO changes occurring during the year. An updated ownership schedule must be certified by the managers and filed with GAFI at the annual shareholders' meeting and whenever a transfer occurs.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general statutory tax holiday; targeted relief under Investment Law No. 72/2017 (up to 50% investment allowance on eligible capital expenditure deducted over 5 years, and up to 50% additional deduction for priority geographic zones), a 5% tax credit for newly created jobs, and exemption of Egyptian-source dividends received by resident LLCs from another Egyptian tax-resident company under Law 91/2005 Article 51; special reduced regimes apply only to listed free-zone companies and petroleum entities, not to a standard LLC.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Egyptian Corporate Income Tax Return (Form No. 19) filed electronically through the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) e-portal at www.etax.gov.eg; accompanied by audited financial statements, the Transfer Pricing Disclosure Form No. 1, and statutory schedules for investment incentives and losses.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual return with quarterly advance CIT instalments
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual Form No. 19 must be filed within 4 months after the end of the LLC's fiscal year (e.g., by 30 April of the following year for a 31 December year-end); quarterly advance instalments of estimated CIT are due by the end of the 4th, 6th, 9th and 12th months of the fiscal year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: LLC legal name, tax card number, commercial registration number, fiscal year-end, authorized address, and line of business.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose full legal name, residence jurisdiction and tax identification number of each non-resident shareholder in the Annex of Related Parties; foreign ownership percentage must be stated accurately for later dividend withholding.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: All gross revenue before deductions: TikTok platform fees, creator commission income, talent management service fees, advertising agency fees, and ancillary campaign revenue.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Convert foreign-currency platform receipts to EGP using the Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) exchange rate prevailing on the date of receipt; ensure no off-book shell account is used to divert revenue outside the Egyptian tax net.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 - Cost of Sales and Direct Creator Compensation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible payments to TikTok creators, subcontractor production costs, content creation expenses, data and equipment costs directly attributable to generating turnover.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For payouts to non-resident creators, attach contracts and proof of arm's length remuneration; incorrectly classifying wages as service fees may trigger 20% WHT and denial of the deduction.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3 - General, Administrative and Marketing Expenses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Office rent, salaries, legal and accounting fees, software subscriptions, marketing and platform advertising costs, and intercompany service charges from the global MCN head office.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Intercompany charges from the foreign parent are deductible only if supported by a full transfer pricing study demonstrating arm's length value; management-fee creep without substance is a red flag for the ETA.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4 - Net Profit / Loss before Carryforward
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accounting profit or loss computed under Egyptian Commercial Law and adjusted for tax disallowances, depreciation differences, and prior-year adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Egyptian LLC is taxed on worldwide income; global TikTok MCN revenue may not be omitted on the assertion that it has no Egyptian source, unless a genuine foreign PE exists with full attribution of profits.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deduction of eligible loss carryforward from prior years, limited to the lesser of the loss incurred or 100% of the current taxable base, within the 5-year statutory window.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Maintain a formal loss register reconciling annual computations; loss carryforward claims are denied where the ownership or business purpose changes without commercial substance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 6 - Tax Base After Incentives and Exemptions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable profit after applying investment allowances, labor tax credits, and dividend exemption schedules.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim only Law 72/2017 incentives for which the LLC holds the required investment certificate; incentives are forfeited if the project relocates or ceases operations within the statutory holding period.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Application of the standard corporate income tax rate of 22.5% to the adjusted tax base.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No treaty or free-zone reduction applies to a standard resident LLC; a lower rate applies only to specific licensed sectors, so the full statutory rate must be paid.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 8 - Advance Payments and Withholding Tax Credits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Aggregate of quarterly advance CIT instalments, Egyptian WHT credits on domestic interest and dividend income, and provisional payments made during the year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders cannot personally offset withholding credits against the LLC's tax; the LLC must carry separate ledgers for amounts subject to WHT at the source.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net cash position: additional CIT payable to the ETA or refundable amount after credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any proposed distribution of after-tax profits to non-resident shareholders is subject to an additional 10% dividend WHT at the payor level; treaty relief must be processed before distribution.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a delay tax of 2% per month (or part thereof) on the unpaid CIT, capped at 6% of the tax due; additional administrative fines of EGP 10,000 to EGP 1,000,000 apply under Law No. 206/2020; fraudulent filing carries criminal sanctions of imprisonment for 6 months to 5 years and a fine of 100% to 200% of the evaded tax.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke an Egyptian double tax agreement, the non-resident shareholder must submit to the Egyptian paying LLC before the distribution date: (i) ETA Treaty Relief Application Form; (ii) a valid Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by the shareholder's resident tax authority, notarized and legalized; (iii) a beneficial ownership declaration confirming no pass-through to a third-jurisdiction resident; and (iv) the applicable DTA article. The payer then withholds at the treaty rate; if the payer has already applied the statutory 10%, the non-resident may reclaim the excess through an ETA administrative refund request within the statutory time limits, generally 5 years from the end of the tax year of distribution.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties paid to non-residents: 20% statutory WHT, generally reduced to 5%-15% under Egyptian DTAs. Interest paid to non-resident lenders: 20% statutory WHT, generally reduced to 5%-15% under Egyptian DTAs; interest paid to a foreign parent is deductible only if arm's length and fully documented, and Egypt's GAAR may disallow interest on back-to-back or thin-capitalization structures.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: EGP 10,000,000 aggregate gross value of related-party transactions per fiscal year (Cabinet Decree No. 381/2020) triggers mandatory Local File and Master File documentation; a simplified Transfer Pricing Disclosure Form No. 1 must be attached to the annual CIT return regardless of transaction value.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Egypt does not have a standalone Economic Substance Regulation (ESR) statute; however, Law 91/2005 Article 30 (GAAR) permits the ETA to disregard transactions lacking commercial substance, and Egyptian CFC rules attribute low-tax foreign profits to the Egyptian shareholder. Management and administrative fees, royalties, and service charges paid to non-resident related parties are deductible only to the extent arm's length and supported by real economic activity; payments exceeding substance-backed value may be disallowed, and royalties to foreign related parties are subject to an additional 30% of the local taxable base cap.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Systematically under-declaring TikTok creator commission revenue, issuing forged creator payout invoices, or shifting global MCN revenue to offshore shell accounts without arm's length recharging agreements.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Imprisonment for 6 months to 5 years and a fine of 100% to 200% of the evaded tax under Law 91/2005; delay tax of 2% per month (capped at 6% of unpaid tax); ETA can seize bank accounts, freeze assets and liquidate the LLC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and actual managers are jointly and severally liable for the LLC's unpaid taxes and monetary penalties; ETA enforcement extends to personal assets of signatories, travel bans are routinely imposed for tax debts, and criminal conviction results in imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a nominal Egyptian LLC without real staff, premises, or operational substance while booking all MCN income abroad, using nominee directors or dormant companies to conceal the true beneficial owner and avoid Egyptian CIT on digital talent management income.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ETA recharacterizes the foreign income as Egyptian-source, denies expense deductions and treaty benefits, imposes 22.5% CIT plus concealment penalties of up to 100% of the assessed tax under Law No. 206/2020, and cancels the commercial registration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Beneficial owners and nominee directors face civil restitution of the underpaid tax, criminal sanctions for false declarations and forged documents, personal asset confiscation, travel bans, and disqualification from acting as directors in Egypt.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Channeling TikTok creator payouts through layered shell entities, crypto mixers, prepaid cards, or nominee bank accounts to obscure the source, destination or beneficial ownership of global MCN earnings.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Egyptian Money Laundering Law No. 80/2002 (as amended): imprisonment from 5 to 15 years, fines of EGP 100,000 to EGP 1,000,000, freezing and confiscation of laundered proceeds, and revocation of the LLC's commercial license; the Egyptian Financial Intelligence Unit may trigger international asset-tracing.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, compliance officers and beneficial owners are criminally liable if they knowingly facilitate laundering; personal bank accounts and assets can be frozen, travel bans are mandatory during investigation, and extradition under mutual legal assistance treaties is possible.
